decisions.reason: We keep it because transactional email is a direct extension of our core secure high-volume messaging capabilities, and our existing platforms and in-house R&D give us strong absorptive capacity to refine it commercially despite some risk of repositioning or bundling.

We keep it because the feature is highly related to our established fax and delivery know-how and can be supported efficiently with existing knowledge, although its narrower scope and weaker fit with the longer-term shift beyond fax make it more disposable than our main services.

We keep it because threat protection fits our secure messaging and compliance position very closely, and our own R&D and customer feedback loops give us the absorptive capacity to learn from use and improve the service further.
